_readme: cherry.vc (Webflow, 2026): the 94 /founder-companies/<slug> pages in the sitemap of 2026-09-04 fetched directly (name, description, mission, founders, founded, industry, location, website) joined with the /founders list page (industry tag, tagline, '(EXIT)' marker, list membership: 90 of 94 are on the list; automation-hero, cazoo, coral and drover have pages only). The site publishes no investment date, stage or partner. Two pages are placeholders named '<x>-information-missing' (Tola, Together). Cazoo and Xometry are acquirers of portfolio companies (Drover, Shift) listed under the acquirer's name. Names of nine 2024-2026 pages whose rendered title sits below the page's hero (the extractor fell back to the URL slug) are set from the Sanity CMS rendering / the company's own brand casing (Black Forest Labs, Alice.Tech, Coral, Dash0, Integral, Kiku, Maze, Trace.Space, telli).
